result.title: Where is My Mug? Training-Free Framework for Personalized Image Segmentation
result.summary: \textbf{Personalized Image Segmentation (PIS)} aims to segment the specific object in a target image that matches a user-provided reference. Unlike category-based segmentation or few-shot segmentation, PIS must discriminate between multiple visually similar instances, a requirement central to deployed applications such as augmented reality, personalized content editing, robotics manipulation, inventory tracking, and fine-grained visual retrieval. We show that the strong numbers reported by existing PIS methods are largely an artifact of single-instance benchmarks: when evaluated on realistic scenes with several same-category look-alikes, prior point-prompt methods collapse, because the correct instance is frequently never surfaced as a prompt. We trace this to a recall bottleneck rather than a mask-quality one, and address it with a training-free, modular system. The pipeline first generates high-recall object proposals using an off-the-shelf class-agnostic detector, then matches each proposal to the reference using foundation-model features (e.g., BLIP-2), and finally refines the selected box with SAM. For robust matching we propose \textbf{top-$K$ Sinkhorn}, a patch-level distance that scores each candidate only on its most confidently matched patches; trimming the Sinkhorn dual potentials recovers the robustness of partial optimal transport at more than $100\times$ lower cost, keeping it inside the per-proposal candidate loop. To evaluate this regime, we introduce \textbf{\datasetname}, a realistic multi-instance benchmark. Across \datasetname, PerSeg, PerMIS, and DAVIS, our system surpasses PerSAM, $\mathrm{P}^2\mathrm{SAM}$, and PDM by up to $\sim\!48$ mIoU while matching their runtime and using fewer parameters, establishing a strong, deployable training-free baseline for real-world personalized segmentation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究个性化图像分割：指出以往方法在多实例相似场景下的高分源自单实例基准，真实失败源于「正确实例未被提为候选」的召回瓶颈，进而提出免训练流程（类别无关检测器生成高召回提案、BLIP-2 特征匹配、top-K Sinkhorn 打分、SAM 细化）并构建多实例基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先高召回生成候选、再用 patch 级 top-K Sinkhorn 与参考匹配筛选」的流程及召回而非掩码质量是瓶颈的诊断，可能为 LVR 的视觉证据筛选、候选未被暴露即失败及相似度中内容与位置因素提供核查线索，但论文本身不涉及 latent 推理状态或生成机制。
